dataset.name: financial_fraud_kaggle
dataset.label_definition: positive = the account appears on at least one transaction whose is_fraud flag is true. The published flag marks card-not-present fraud, not money laundering
notes: Card-fraud data with a single fraud_type. Not an AML benchmark.

Currency is unstated; the amount column is 'amount'.
